subject.title: refactor(agents): retire TOOLS.md into an AGENTS.md section with a doctor migration

question: Should existing workspaces be required to run `openclaw doctor --fix` before their former `TOOLS.md` notes continue reaching agent context and governed policy evaluation?
rationale: The code intentionally removes the runtime reader and introduces a fail-closed policy finding, so this is a user-upgrade behavior choice rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Accept Doctor-gated migration
options.body: Merge the canonical-file retirement and require affected operators to run Doctor, relying on the documented migration and policy fix hint.

options.title: Preserve legacy notes temporarily
options.body: Retain a time-bounded compatibility route until a more visible in-product migration or recovery surface is available.

options.title: Pause for release-path design
options.body: Defer the retirement until maintainers define how upgrades surface the required migration to existing workspaces.

recommendation.title: Accept Doctor-gated migration
recommendation.body: Merge the canonical-file retirement and require affected operators to run Doctor, relying on the documented migration and policy fix hint.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed workspace-attestation work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the migration and its upgrade boundary.
